canonical_project: LG U+ Pyeongchon Mega Center (incl. Pyeongchon 2)
notes: Hyperscale IDC in Anyang (Pyeongchon); opened Jul 2016, Asia's largest at opening; Uptime Tier-III certified; PUE ~1.4; LG Corp reported ~165MW planned power supply; Pyeongchon 2 expansion (40,450 sqm, 200,000+ servers) per LG U+ official insight pages.
